definitions.explanation: An approximate number of people, typically implying somewhere between two or three and about ten. A common way to express a small, indefinite number of people.

examples.japanese: {数人|すうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met with a few friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数人|すうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Several students were still in the classroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数人|すうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧がいた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{異|こと}なっていた→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: There were several eyewitnesses at the accident scene, but their testimonies differed.

notes: The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧～ means "several" or "a few" and combines with many counters: ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧ (several times), ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧ (several days), ⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧ (several years), ⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧ (several hundred). The range implied by ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧～ is roughly 2–9, though context determines the perceived quantity. Related: ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (some number of people — similar but phrased as a question-based indefinite), {数名|すうめい} (several people — more formal variant using {名|めい}).
